about.title: Serving Genuine Flavours at the Heart of Dhaka
about.bengaliTitle: দ্যা সিলভানা রেস্টুরেন্ট — ঐতিহ্য ও খাঁটি স্বাদের মেলবন্ধন
about.story1: Situated at 10, Shahbagh Biponi Bithan, The Sylvana Restaurant (দ্যা সিলভানা রেস্টুরেন্ট) is proud to be a warm culinary landmark in Dhaka. We bring together time-honoured Bengali cooking traditions, authentic Old Dhaka spices, and contemporary gourmet dining under one welcoming roof.
about.story2: From our early morning flaky Parathas with rich Dim Bhuna or Bhaji, to our midday aromatic Mutton Kacchi Biryani and comforting Alu Bhorta with Rui fish curry, every dish is prepared with fresh local ingredients, genuine care, and uncompromised hygiene.
about.story3: Whether you are stopping by for our famous Masala Milk Tea and crispy Samosas, a gourmet Beef Burger melted with cheese, or a comforting plate of steamed rice with Rui Fish Curry and Alu Bhorta, we welcome you with open arms.
highlights: Authentic recipes rooted in traditional Bangladeshi culinary craft
100% Halal fresh meat, poultry, and daily-sourced produce
Welcoming family environment, student-friendly rates, and quick takeaway service

faqs.question: Where is The Sylvana Restaurant located in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: The Sylvana Restaurant is located at 10, Shahbagh Biponi Bithan, Dhaka-1000, Bangladesh. We are centrally situated in the historic Shahbagh intersection, easily accessible from Dhaka University, BSMMU, and the National Museum.

faqs.question: What are your operating hours?
faqs.answer: We are open 7 days a week, Monday through Sunday, from 7:00 AM in the morning until 11:30 PM at night. Breakfast is served starting at 7:00 AM, with lunch, snacks, and dinner continuing throughout the day.

faqs.question: Are all food items 100% Halal?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. All meat (beef, mutton, chicken) is 100% Halal certified and freshly procured every morning from trusted local suppliers. We maintain the highest standards of culinary hygiene.

faqs.question: Can I reserve a table in advance or order takeaways?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can reserve a table or place a takeaway parcel order using the reservation form below on this website, or by calling our hotline directly at +8801734489275.

faqs.question: How many dishes are on your menu?
faqs.answer: We feature 38 curated dishes and refreshments spanning authentic Bengali breakfast, traditional slow-cooked meals (Biryani, Tehari, Khichuri), soups, appetizers, gourmet burgers, pizza, pasta, traditional sweets, and refreshing lassis and juices.
